KIND:       shared_office365users
SCHEMA:     connector (vendor/skills-for-copilot-studio @ 9c42d3a)

DESCRIPTION:
    Office 365 Users: Office 365 Users Connection provider lets you access user
    profiles in your organization using your Office 365 account. You can get
    your profile, a user's profile, a user's manager, or direct reports.

    connectorId: /providers/Microsoft.PowerApps/apis/shared_office365users
    connectorType: Public
    6 operations, 0 triggers

    YAML: `kind: ConnectorDefinition`

FIELDS:
  MyProfile_V2	<Operation>
    Get my profile (V2): Retrieves the profile of the current user from
    Microsoft Graph. Learn more:
    https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/docs/api-reference/v1.0/resources/user#properties
    display name: Get my profile (V2)

  UserProfile_V2	<Operation>
    Get user profile (V2): Retrieves a specific user's profile from Microsoft
    Graph by user principal name or user ID.
    display name: Get user profile (V2)

  UserPhoto	<Operation>
    Get user photo: Retrieves the photo of the specified user or the current
    user.
    display name: Get user photo

  SearchUser_V2	<Operation>
    Search for users (V2): Searches for users in the organization by name,
    email, or other attributes using Microsoft Graph.
    display name: Search for users (V2)

  DirectReports_V2	<Operation>
    Get direct reports (V2): Retrieves the direct reports of the specified user
    from Microsoft Graph.
    display name: Get direct reports (V2)

  Manager_V2	<Operation>
    Get manager (V2): Retrieves the manager of the specified user from Microsoft
    Graph.
    display name: Get manager (V2)
